many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def dihed_ops(w):
    g=[list(r) for r in w]

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

I2,O2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
# Hypothesis A: output = transpose, except band 6-cells get value from rotating grid about center (180) when that is nonzero;
# else fall back to nearest non-6 via diagonal propagation along main diagonal direction.
def f(a):
    w=len(a); h=len(a[0])
    out=[[a[c][r] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if out[r][c]==6:
                # try 180 rot
                rr,cc=w-1-r,c-1+0 if False else (w-1-c,h-1-r) if False else (h-1-r,w-1-c)
                # careful sizes square
                rr,cc=h-1-r,w-1-c
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and a[rr][cc]!=6: out[r][c]=a[rr][cc]
                elif a[h-1-r][c-h+1+c-1] if False else False: pass
    return out
print(f(I2)==O2)
